about.title: Roots that feed a neighbourhood
about.lead: Arrels means roots: the bond with the land, with the growers we know by name, and with a neighbourhood we walk through every day.
paragraphs: For decades we've opened the shutters in the Eixample with the same gesture: choosing the best produce of the day, one piece at a time, before the neighbourhood has fully woken up.
We're not a chain, and we don't want to be one. We're a lifelong local shop that decided to do things properly: fewer food miles, more flavour, and a rapport that only years can earn.
Working with growers and cooperatives across Catalonia isn't a label, it's our everyday. We know who plants, who waters, and who picks what ends up on our counter.

products.title: The season, as it is
products.intro: No forced calendars. What you see on the counter is what the land gives right now — vivid colours, just the right ripeness, and barely any distance travelled.
